## Current priority

Release two demonstration products as quickly as possible:
1. New Year invitation — first.
2. Wedding invitation — second.

Current sequence:
1. Documentation navigation and release plan alignment — completed Nov 14.
2. Focused code review of the existing Demo scaffold — completed Nov 14; no confirmed P0 blockers found, several P1 mismatches recorded.
3. Design the invitation templates using the existing functional base.
4. Implement only the minimal P1 support: product-specific visual theme, New Year first/default selection, wedding signature visibility, invitation-level family greeting style.
5. Prepare and demonstrate the New Year product first.
6. Prepare and demonstrate the wedding product next.
7. Defer nonessential improvements until demonstrations begin.

Previously discussed wedding visual decisions must be preserved. The New Year visual direction has not yet been discussed and must be developed separately.

## Source hierarchy

- Approved specifications and full working roadmap: private repository PelzA83/EventFlow.
- Public Demo code and verified user-flow status: PelzA83/eventflow-demo.
- Detailed architecture, audits, database materials, decisions and changelog: private repository PelzA83/eventflow-project-docs.
- This public Hub: curated navigation and summary only; not a source of truth when private or live Demo sources differ.

## Important limitations

The public Demo uses SharedWorker and in-memory session data. It is not persistent storage and is not connected to the production Supabase database. Do not promise persistence across completed sessions or independent devices.

## Public Demo

- Start: https://pelza83.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo.html
- Organizer: https://pelza83.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo-organizer.html
- Guest invitation: https://pelza83.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo-guest.html

Open both organizer and guest pages through the start page to use the same demo session.
